title: Gateway ping and sensor telemetry SSH fallback hardening
acceptance_criteria: Gateway summary retries via generate when show ping is invalid.
Gateway summary falls back to SSH ping when API ping commands are unavailable.
System dashboard summary falls back to SSH sensors when API sensor commands are unavailable.
Gateway and dashboard temperature regression tests cover API-to-SSH fallback behavior.
Runtime smoke checks pass after backend restart.
assumptions: Some VyOS builds reject op-mode ping and sensors through HTTPS API commands.
SSH automation key access can be unavailable on some systems; endpoint should still fail gracefully with warning.
Unrelated dirty files in the working tree are pre-existing and out of scope for this hotfix.

tasks.notes: Added SSH fallback for gateway ping probes and dashboard sensor collection while preserving API contract.
Added regressions for API invalid-command fallback to SSH paths.
Manual review completed; changes remain additive and thin-wrapper compliant.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_gateway_summary.py tests/test_system_dashboard_temperature.py tests/test_system_lldp_parsing.py tests/test_safe_apply.py
